why: A delivers a cohesive classic look: rolled-arm sofa, wingback pair, medallion rug, dark wood table, ornate gold mirror and a fabric-shaded turned lamp, all suited to the moulded room. Its only miss is a charcoal sofa instead of dark green velvet. B's sofa is closer in color but mid-century modern, and the industrial tray table and chrome orb lamp break the classic brief and clash with the room.
